canonical.title: A weekend in Brusaporto, anchored on Da Vittorio

sources.title: La Dimora — Da Vittorio
sources.claim: La Dimora is Da Vittorio's 10-room Relais & Châteaux at Via Cantalupa 17; Junior Suite €700, Double €650.

sources.title: Joia Hotel — Italia.it
sources.claim: Da Vittorio is approximately a 19-minute walk from Joia Hotel.

sources.title: Brusaporto → Erbusco — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: Brusaporto to Erbusco is 22.9 km / ~23 min by car.

sources.title: Monte Isola ferry — Navigazione Lago d'Iseo
sources.claim: Sulzano–Monte Isola ferry: ~5-minute crossing, every 15–20 min, year-round.

sources.title: Relais San Vigilio al Castello
sources.claim: 9-room boutique in restored 1630 castle barracks atop San Vigilio hill.

sources.title: GombitHotel
sources.claim: 12 rooms + 3 suites by designer Giò Pozzi inside a 13th-c. medieval tower in Città Alta.

sources.title: Taxi Bergamo rates
sources.claim: Night tariff (21:00–06:00): €7.60 base + €1.28 per km.

sources.title: Villa Redona
sources.claim: 16th-c. Medolago Albani wine-estate agriturismo in Trescore Balneario; €155–200.

sources.title: Lake Endine walks — Komoot
sources.claim: Ranzanico loop ~5.67 km, ~10 m gain, dog-friendly lakeside paths.

sources.title: Forum Robotica Innovativa 2026
sources.claim: Thu 18 Jun 2026, 8:45–17:30 at Kilometro Rosso GATE 4, Bergamo.

sources.title: APMS 2026
sources.claim: Sep 13–17 2026 at University of Bergamo: sustainable, data-driven, human-centric production systems.

sources.title: BergamoScienza 2026 — Convergenze
sources.claim: XXIV edition runs Oct 1–11 2026 across Bergamo.

sources.title: Cantalupa estate — Da Vittorio
sources.claim: Ten hectares with two natural lakes; ~10 min by car from Bergamo.

sources.title: Da Vittorio — contacts & helicopter
sources.claim: Helicopter arrivals via Air-Dynamic; single call to bind room + table.

sources.title: Da Vittorio — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: Three Michelin stars, 2026 Italia guide.

sources.title: Da Vittorio — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Both restaurant (3★) and 10-room hotel are Relais & Châteaux properties.

sources.title: Joia Hotel official
sources.claim: Joia Hotel at Via Cascina La Cà SNC, Brusaporto; pool, free WiFi, 24-hr reception, pets allowed.

sources.title: Joia Hotel — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: 4.1/5 (196 reviews); 'out in the middle of a field'; $153–$221 standard room.

sources.title: Da Vittorio — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: 4.7/5 (195 reviews); #1 of 2 hotels in Brusaporto; $690–$943/night.

sources.title: Hotel Piazza Vecchia
sources.claim: 13 rooms in a 14th-c. townhouse on Bergamo Città Alta's main street.

sources.title: Relais San Lorenzo
sources.claim: 5-star, 30-room luxury hotel in Bergamo Alta over Roman remains visible through crystal floors.

sources.title: B&B Corte Seguini
sources.claim: 1600s building in Bagnatica; 5-min walk to centre; rooms $155–$179; Booking 9.6.

sources.title: Petronilla Hotel
sources.claim: Boutique in Bergamo's lower town with rooms decorated around modern art.

sources.title: Piazza Vecchia — Visit Bergamo
sources.claim: Centrepiece of Città Alta — Palazzo della Ragione (Lombardy's oldest municipal seat), Campanone, Contarini fountain.

sources.title: Cappella Colleoni — Visit Bergamo
sources.claim: March–Oct 09:30–12:30 / 14:00–18:30, closed Mondays, free; equestrian monument to Bartolomeo Colleoni.

sources.title: Venetian Walls — Visit Bergamo
sources.claim: UNESCO-listed 2017; ~6 km circuit, 14 bastions, four monumental gates.

sources.title: Venetian Walls — Italia.it
sources.claim: Sunset walk along the walls delivers views over Città Bassa, the Milan plain and the Orobian Pre-Alps.

sources.title: Funicolare Città Alta — Visit Bergamo
sources.claim: 85 m climb on 240 m of track; Sat service to 01:15.

sources.title: Berlucchi — cellar tours
sources.claim: I Classici €33pp; Iconici €44pp; Berlucchi Experience €70pp; Spring Experience €85pp.

sources.title: Ca' del Bosco — visits
sources.claim: By appointment, ~1h30; access to the in-house wine shop reserved for booked visitors.

sources.title: Bellavista — Franciacorta
sources.claim: Visit Alma €25, Bellavista's Harvest €40, Bellavista Experience €70 — by appointment only.

sources.title: Mosnel — visits and tastings
sources.claim: Weekend cellar walk + tasting from €10pp; 'Mosnel Style' 3-wine flight €30pp.

sources.title: Strada del Franciacorta
sources.claim: ~80 km signed wine route through 19 municipalities; 122 affiliated wineries.

sources.title: Festival di Franciacorta 2026
sources.claim: Confirmed 18–20 September 2026 in Erbusco — normally-private estates opened for tastings.

sources.title: Visit Monte Isola — getting there
sources.claim: Sulzano and Sale Marasino are the two harbours with direct ferries to Monte Isola, every ~20 min.

sources.title: Visit Monte Isola — trekking
sources.claim: Peschiera Maraglio → Madonna della Ceriola: 4 km, +400 m, ~80 min one way.

sources.title: Trattoria del Sole — Sensole
sources.claim: Founded 1974 by Albina Guizzetti in a lakeside olive grove; lake fish — dried Iseo sardines, tench, lavarello.

sources.title: Monte Isola — Visit Brescia
sources.claim: Car-free except for residents — mopeds, bicycles and a few buses between villages.

sources.title: The Floating Piers — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Christo's Floating Piers (18 Jun – 3 Jul 2016) used 70,000 m² of yellow fabric on 226,000 polyethylene cubes.

sources.title: Crespi d'Adda — Visitor Centre
sources.claim: UNESCO Visitor Centre at Corso Manzoni 18, Capriate San Gervasio; Sat 08:45–17:45, Sun 08:45–18:30.

sources.title: Crespi d'Adda — standard tour
sources.claim: Standard guided village tour €8pp (Italian only); 90 min on weekends late Feb – Nov.

sources.title: Crespi d'Adda — complete tour
sources.claim: Special complete tours (Easter Mon, 25 Apr, 1 May, 2 Jun 2026) ~3 h, €19/adult; includes Bertini plant, museum, VR factory.

sources.title: Traghetto di Leonardo — Il Post
sources.claim: Cable-and-current catamaran ferry sketched by Leonardo (1513); €1.50 single, no cars.

sources.title: Accademia Carrara — exhibitions
sources.claim: TAROT: Origins, Cards, Fortunes — 27 Feb – 2 Jun 2026; largest tarot exhibition ever.

sources.title: Mazzo Colleoni reunion — Revenews
sources.claim: 15th-c. Mazzo Colleoni reunited for the first time in over a century — cards from Morgan Library and private collections.

sources.title: GAMeC × Palazzo della Ragione
sources.claim: 'I tarocchi di De André' video installation runs to 3 May 2026, Thu–Sun 11:00–19:00, free.

sources.title: Bergamo Jazz Summer 2026
sources.claim: Open-air evenings at the Lazzaretto: Thu 2 July and Sat 18 July 2026 (Dee Dee Bridgewater) at 21:30.

sources.title: Kilometro Rosso
sources.claim: ~80 resident partners and 2,500 employees/researchers at the manufacturing-innovation district.

sources.title: University of Bergamo — events
sources.claim: Umbrella events calendar for ad-hoc AI/engineering lectures at the Sant'Agostino campus.

sources.title: Villa Redona rates — Val Cavallina
sources.claim: Standard double €155, superior €185, suite €200.
